classifications.rationale: The President only recounts a 1977 proclamation and agreement; this segment performs no present governance or legal act.
classifications.evidence: I proclaimed (Presidential Proclamation 4511) that the Government of the United States of America and the Government of Japan had entered into an orderly marketing agreement

classifications.rationale: The President reports a delegation already made in Proclamation 4511 rather than making a new delegation in this segment.
classifications.evidence: In Proclamation 4511 I delegated my authority

classifications.rationale: The Special Representative makes, and the President concurs in, a statutory determination that the Japan agreement is no longer effective; that present determination carries the legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: the orderly marketing agreement with Japan does not continue to be effective. I concur with that determination.

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory determination that the proclaimed relief satisfies the required minimum import level.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that the level of import relief hereinafter proclaimed permits the importation into the United States of a quantity or value of articles which is not less than the average annual quantity or value

classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory determination identifying the representative comparison period used for import relief.
classifications.evidence: I have determined to be the most recent representative period for imports of such articles.

classifications.rationale: The President immediately modifies the tariff schedules and gives effect to the specified trade regime; subsequent implementation is ministerial.
classifications.evidence: Subpart A, part 2 of the Appendix to the Tariff Schedules of the United States (19 U.S.C. 1202) is modified as set forth in the Annex to this proclamation.

classifications.rationale: The President assigns negotiating authority to the Special Representative, an internal delegation that does not dictate a later agreement's terms.
classifications.evidence: is hereby delegated to the Special Representative.

classifications.rationale: The President delegates authority to make a future effectiveness determination without dictating whether or how that authority must be exercised.
classifications.evidence: is hereby delegated to the Special Representative, to be exercised in conformity with paragraph (5) below.

classifications.rationale: The segment assigns implementation, consultation, monitoring, and discretionary restriction authority to executive officials; it does not itself impose a particular future restriction.
classifications.evidence: the Special Representative may initiate consultations with those countries responsible for such disruptions and may prevent further entry of such articles

classifications.rationale: The segment establishes consultation and procedural timing requirements governing any discretionary future restriction, rather than itself imposing one.
classifications.evidence: Before exercising this authority, the Special Representative shall consult with representatives of the member agencies of the Trade Policy Staff Committee.

classifications.rationale: The Special Representative must administer and implement the agreements and related provisions, with the particular necessary actions left to executive discretion.
classifications.evidence: shall take such actions and perform such functions for the United States as may be necessary

classifications.rationale: The segment authorizes the Special Representative to make further internal delegations for administration and implementation.
classifications.evidence: is authorized to delegate to appropriate officials or agencies of the United States authority

classifications.rationale: The Special Representative receives discretionary authority to make later tariff-schedule changes; the segment does not dictate a specified change.
classifications.evidence: is authorized to make any changes in Part 2 of the Appendix to the TSUS which may be necessary

classifications.rationale: Read with the continued sentence, this fragment directs the Commissioner of Customs to perform implementation actions selected by the Special Representative.
classifications.evidence: The Commissioner of Customs shall take such actions as the Special Representative

classifications.rationale: Although it completes an implementation direction, the segment itself also fixes the proclamation's effective date and duration, presently defining when its legal regime operates.
classifications.evidence: This proclamation shall be effective as of February 1, 1979, and shall continue in force through June 30, 1980
